answer: Stake-weighted onboarding: every new agent escrows 60 tokens across a 10-epoch horizon, so 40 clones x 60 = 2,400 tokens sit idle for 10 epochs. If one clone is flagged, a ripple slash hits every account sharing its funding bridge, cutting 30% (720 tokens) at once, jointly. Honest agents risk 18; a farm risks 720 on a single mistake.
